evals.name: fresh-jira-keeps-defaults
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call Jira or write files. Configure a fresh Jira project with no prior tracker conventions. Describe the project config produced.
evals.expected_output: Copy the Jira tracker template and the handoff-comment policy into docs/agents/ unchanged, without running an existing-system adoption audit.
assertions: Uses the bundled Jira tracker template defaults without modification.
Produces docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and docs/agents/handoff-comment.md and nothing else.
Keeps fresh setup concise and does not require existing-system reconciliation.

evals.name: adopt-mature-jira
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call Jira or write files. Adopt a mature Jira project. Repo and live metadata agree on assignee claims, but use Improvement instead of Story, Initiative parents instead of Epics, Depends on instead of Blocks, and REL-123 branch/commit/PR rules through a jira-wrapper CLI. Describe the configuration diff.
evals.expected_output: Reconcile repository evidence against live Jira metadata, then record the differing issue type, hierarchy, dependency, and CLI conventions directly in docs/agents/issue-tracker.md, leaving matching defaults implicit.
assertions: Reconciles repository evidence with live Jira metadata before proposing configuration.
Preserves jira-wrapper, Improvement, Initiative, Depends on, REL-123 conventions, permissions, and reporting rules.
Records the differences in issue-tracker.md rather than a separate mapping file.
Shows the proposed configuration diff before writing anything.

evals.name: existing-jira-no-vocabulary-approval
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call Jira or write files. The existing Jira has no suitable dependency link type. The user authorizes local setup but does not authorize Jira labels, fields, types, or workflow/schema changes. Describe the proposed diff.
evals.expected_output: Record a portable body fallback for the unsupported dependency concept only, propose no persistent Jira change, and leave unrelated defaults intact.
assertions: Requires explicit named authorization before introducing persistent Jira vocabulary or schema.
Records a portable body fallback for only the unsupported concept.
Does not turn the tracker into a generalized adapter mode or alter unrelated defaults.

evals.name: partial-jira-read-access
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call Jira or write files. Issue reads work, but project metadata, permissions, and transitions return 403, and repo docs disagree about the project key. Describe setup's result.
evals.expected_output: Record known evidence and stop before guessed configuration writes, naming the exact missing fact needed next.
assertions: Treats filtered metadata as unknown rather than absent.
Does not guess a project key or write configuration from incomplete evidence.
Names the access or identity fact required to continue.
